title: Group definitions
subtitle: Declared fleet groups (#1032): a static member list or a dynamic SQL query that returns pc_ids. A schedule's target.groups resolves these in addition to manual agent-group membership.
empty: No group definitions yet. Create one here, or apply YAML with `kanade group def create`.

confirm.deleteDescription: Removes the group definition. Schedules targeting it stop resolving members via this group (manual agent_groups membership is untouched).
